title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 EDNS(0) and DNS Message Size Work Item
summary: Enforce the DoQ 65535-byte maximum message size in the codec layer and verify the EDNS(0) UDP payload size field is ignored for message-size admission.
planned_changes:
- Add explicit payload-length validation in DoqMessageCodec.TryDecode that rejects values exceeding MaxPayloadLength.
- Add boundary tests for 65534-, 65535-, and 65536-byte payloads, plus fuzz-style tests for malformed length prefixes and overflow attempts.
- Verify existing Encode already rejects oversized payloads.
- Confirm the codec never consults the EDNS(0) UDP payload size field (this is guaranteed by design; the codec operates only on the 2-octet length prefix).
verification_plan: Run the DoQ foundation tests (including new boundary/fuzz tests), core SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: DNS message body parsing beyond the length prefix.
completion_notes: The DoqMessageCodec now explicitly enforces the 65535-byte maximum message size with boundary and fuzz tests. The EDNS(0) UDP payload size field is structurally ignored.
